brief:
Jordan disclosed details of a meeting between Syrian and Israeli officials held in the capital on Sunday to discuss de-escalation and reducing tensions in Syria, the Shehab Wire reported. The talks were convened at the request of the Syrian government and proceeded under American mediation.

The encounter marked a rare direct engagement between Damascus and Jerusalem through a regional intermediary. Officials from both sides gathered to explore diplomatic pathways for calming the volatile situation across Syria, though specifics of the discussions and any agreements reached were not immediately disclosed.
